As he reflects on his austere upbringing under the influence of his father, the esteemed Isaac Ford, Percival grapples with his own insecurities and moral viewpoints. The complex relationship with his half-brother Joe Garland, who embodies the carefree spirit Ford despises, becomes central to the narrative.
